question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The event, promised to be a grand show, will see a display of grit, ________ and mettle.
solution:
The correct answer is option no.(3) i.e.** 'Zeal'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, we need a word close to the meaning of** 'Happy or Enthusiasm' **to fill in the blank.
 
• **Let's see the meaning of the given words:**
 
 
• **Zenith:** The time or place at which something is the most powerful or successful.**(शीर्ष / चोटी )**
 
• **Umbrage:** Offence, annoyance or exasperation .**(रोष) ** 
 
• **Zeal:** Great energy or enthusiasm.**(उत्साह/जोश)**
 
• **Tyro: **A beginner or novice**.(नवसिखुआ)**
 
 
 
• From the meanings of the words, we can say that **'Zeal'** is the most appropriate answer.
 
• The complete sentence is:***The event, promised to be a grand show, will see a display of grit, zeal__ and mettle.***

Therefore, the correct answer is option no.**(3)**
